intro: The preview shows the camera image with the calculated color correction. Left of the divider you see the camera image, right of it the corrected image. You can drag the divider in the image or move it with the arrow keys. The camera icon at the top right of the image takes a still image and switches the camera off.
captureTitle: Take a still image and switch the camera off
noModelText: Calculate it first in the “Color cards” tab. Then you will see the camera image before and after here.
noSourceText: Switch the camera on above with “{button}” to see the live image or to take a still image.
divider: Divider: {left} on the left, {right} on the right
emptyNoCards: This view needs measured color cards.
tilesLegend: Each patch: target, camera, corrected (from left to right).
pointsLegend: Points on the 0–100 scale: + color gets stronger, − weaker.

errors.linkFailed: Shader program could not be linked: {log}
errors.noContext: Neither WebGL2 nor a 2D drawing context is available, so the preview is not possible.
